title: Development of the AI Risk Management Framework
learningObjectives: Students learn that the framework is intended for voluntary use to improve trustworthiness across design, development, use, and evaluation.
Students learn that the framework helps manage risks to individuals, organizations, and society associated with artificial intelligence.
Students learn that a generative AI profile helps organizations identify unique risks and proposes actions aligned to their goals.

events.label: Concept note for AI RMF Critical Infrastructure Profile

evidence.quote: On April 7, 2026, NIST released a concept note for an AI RMF Profile on Trustworthy AI in Critical Infrastructure.
The profile will guide critical infrastructure operators towards specific risk management practices to consider when engaging AI-enabled capabilities.
